name: 01002 · Amherst, MA
findings: ZIP 01002 (Amherst) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01002 (Amherst) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01002 (Amherst) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
